Schedule

If you have set Firewall Rules on the Rules page or Keyword Filtering on the Block Sites page, you can set up a schedule for the time of day the rules are applied.

To apply Rules based on a schedule:

  • On the Rules page create the required Rules using either Block by Schedule or Allow by Schedule for each rule.
  • Select the Enable checkbox on that page.
  • Tick the days and times on this page, as required.
  • Select Apply.

Note: If the schedule is modified on this page, this affects ALL Rules which are using a schedule.

Days

Select the days on which you want the rules to apply:

  • Every Day - All days will automatically be selected.
  • Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, etc. - If Every Day isn't selected, you can choose the required days individually.

Time of Day

This determines when the schedule is applied for each day selected. Enter the desired Start and Finish times.

Note: Enter the values in the 24 hour clock format. e.g. 10:30 am would be 10 Hours and 30 Minutes, and 10:30 pm would be 22 Hours and 30 Minutes.
